authors: Alexander Mordvintsev; Ettore Randazzo; Eyvind Niklasson

claim: Differentiable molecular-sequence optimization uses relaxations/gradient estimators and can suffer predictor pathologies on relaxed inputs.

authors: Inhoo Lee; Salvador Buse; Erik Winfree
